grades.upper_bound_mechanism: equal powers/circle coefficients reduced to an unproved identity
grades.notes: States OM=ON and gives a valid trig/oblique-coordinate encoding of the three angle conditions, deriving (II),(III),(V). No independent key circle through A,K,L is identified. OM²−ON² is correctly reduced to (IV), but that identity is unproved; the asserted one-constraint algebraic shortcut is unsupported and false in general.
